class.name: IfcPileType
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: Provides shared material, decomposition, representation maps, and property sets for instances of IfcPile . HISTORY New entity in IFC Release 2x4 Material Use Definition : Material profile set association analogous to IfcColumnStandardCase should be used when applicable.
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: Subtype of pile. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
